css: .trace-log { left:920px; top:200px; width:840px; box-sizing:border-box; padding:22px 28px 24px } .trace-log h4 { margin:0 0 12px; font-size:24px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.08em; color:var(--mute) } .trace-row { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:16px; height:84px; border-top:2px solid var(--hair); font-size:26px } .trace-row b { flex:none; width:120px; font-weight:600 } .trace-row span { flex:1; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis } .trace-row code { font-family:var(--mono, monospace); font-size:23px } .trace-flag { flex:none; padding:7px 16px; border-radius:999px; background:var(--accent); color:var(--ground); font-size:21px; font-weight:600; font-style:normal; white-space:nowrap }
